name: Bowerbird: Screenshots and Folders for Posts
description: Make clean screenshots of posts on x.com and save posts into your own folders. Everything stays on your device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://pbs.twimg.com; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
